study: Two-Stage Order Flow Breakout with Spread Compression: buy-stop breakout with Lee-Ready buyer flow >= 65% when quoted spread compresses to $0.01 (<= 2.85 bp, <= 50% trailing median) vs uncompressed and timing controls.
registered_at: 2026-10-31, after operator READY, before any simulation script execution or outcome read

pipeline_architecture.stage_1: Identify candidate buy-stop breakout minutes on 1m bars across liquid universe

stage_2_fetch.quotes_window: [T - 10m, T + 15m] for trailing median spread and forward markout/leash exits
stage_2_fetch.trades_window: [T - 60s, T] for Lee-Ready signed volume classification

order_flow.algorithm: Lee-Ready signed trades (tick test on midpoint ties)

entry_conditions.breakout_trigger: Price at second T crosses above high of prior 1-minute candle
entry_conditions.fill: SIP Ask price at second T (charging $0.01 spread)

cost_model.exit: Prevailing quoted SIP Bid at exit timestamp (uncompressed spread)

exits.initial_stop: under low of preceding 1-minute candle (or 1.0R ATR)

controls.control_1_uncompressed: Candidate breakouts with buyer flow >= 0.65 where quoted spread is uncompressed (spread > $0.01 OR relative spread > 50% of median)
controls.control_2_flow_contrast: Candidate breakouts with spread compression (spread == $0.01) but buyer flow < 0.50
controls.control_3_placebo: Random minute on same candidate ticker within [T - 30m, T + 30m], evaluated at prevailing SIP Ask/Bid
